title: Mola Salamat Rakkhe
body:
Aza e Shah e Shaheeda'n Manane Walo Ko
Mola Salamat Rakkhe
Ye Farshe Majliso Matam Bichane Walo Ko
Mola Salamat Rakkhe
Alam uthaye Jo Abbas ki mohabbat me
Izafa or ho un bazuwon ki taqat me
Ali ke Sher ka parcham sajane walo ko ...maula salamat rakhe
Juluse shah se Ghar jinke door hote hen
Thakan se Jo bhi masafat ki choor hote hen
Unhe sabeel ka Pani pilaane walo ko ..maula salamat rakhe
Jhula ke jhoola padhi jab ziyarate asghar
Dua ko hath uthaye rabab ne keh Kar
Mere sageer ka jhula jhulaane walo ko....maula salamat rakhe
Hen mustahaq wahi Abbas ki shafa'at ke
Libas baccho ko pehnate hen Jo jannat ke
Sakina Bibi ka saqqa banane walo ko...maula salamat rakhe
Jo arbaeen pa zayar KE kaam aate hen
Gharon ko chorke rasto pa Beth Jate hen
Duwayen kijiye aise gharane walo ko....maula salamat rakhe
Kinara kaat gayi maut ki khawahish se
Kiya hai samna dat Kar jinhone daaish se
Mazare saniye zehra bachane walo ko.....maula salamat rakhe
Inhi ke dam se hai tehzeebe karbala ki namood
Khud ke deen ki quwwat banege inke wujud
Tamam halqaye matam me aane walo ko...
Maula salamat rakhe
Ye Dil jud'a hai sada fatema KE chain KE sath
Dhadkne lagta hai labbaik ya Husain KE sath
Ali ke naam ka Nara lagane walo ko....maula
Qubul karti hu pursa ye fatema ne kaha
Tumhare haq me ye karti hu baar baar Dua
Mere Husain ka nauha sunane walo ko...maula salamat rakhe
Qubul karti hu pursa ye fatema ne kaha
Tumhare haq me ye karti hu baar baar Dua
Mere Husain ka nauha sunane walo ko...maula salamat rakhe
Ye chote chote se bacche hen aashiqe sarwar
Jo krne lagte hen matam Husain kehne per
Inhe hayat ka Matlab sikhaane walo ko ....maula salamat rakhe
Ye nauhakhwan ! azadar ! or Sab Zakir
Husaini maayen hon bacche hon shayaro  zayir
Ye sare matami daste Jo rehte hen hazir
Ghame Husain me rone rulane walo ko
Maula salamat rakhe
Khuda Kare ke ho raazi Husain ki madar
Duwayen karte hen Abbas or Ali Akbar
Khuluse Dil se moharram manane walo ko ....maula salamat rakhe
